_comment: The one list both readers of the token record are held to: the website (app/public/js/token-page.js, SALE_URL) and the bot (bot/formatters/token_card.py, SALE_URL) may print presale.sale_url as a link only when it is an https link on smithii.io or one of its subdomains, written plainly. A sale link is what a phishing clone forges first, so the readers refuse anything else and say the field is unreadable rather than print it. app/test/the_token_page_names_one_mint.test.js and tests/test_the_token_card_reads_the_one_record.py both read this file, so the two rules cannot drift apart. Smithii's own pages are on tools.smithii.io (token/presale/RUNBOOK.md links its Token Vesting tool there).
